title: Field Meter Anomaly — 314 Oak Street

fields.organization: Corwin Valley Gas Company — Distribution Operations
fields.summary: Customer on 314 Oak Street reported gas meter reading 14.5 in. w.c. and a clicking sound from the meter box. Meter is a 2003 model, not registered on SCADA, not linked to any field gauge or pressure recorder. No record exists for this meter in CVG-EP-2026 Section 7 or the Field Meter Log (CVG-FML-2026). Meter is not part of the pressure monitoring network. Customer instructed to call 911 if gas odor is detected.

findings.notes: Not connected to SCADA or field gauge network
No prior record of this meter's pressure
Customer informed to call 911 if odor detected

actionsTaken: Notified Customer Service Manager (Yolanda Price) via internal phone at 20:08
Confirmed meter is not in CVG-EP-2026 Section 7 or CVG-FML-2026
Filed report under CVG-CIRP-2026 Section 4 (Cyber Incident Reporting) as non-impactful anomaly
recommendations: Add to field audit list for quarterly review of unregistered meters
Verify if meter was ever registered under old system (CVG-OLD-2000)
fields.photosNote: 1 photo attached: IMG_1024-2005-0048 (meter box, 314 Oak St, 20:05)

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it as a non-impactful meter anomaly and not escalate. The FOS should log and close the report.
